items.definition:
relating to or suffering from psychopathy
The character displayed psychopathic tendencies.

relating to or affecting the rectum
The doctor performed a rectal examination.

relating to or involving a procedure whereby a mathematical or computational process is repeated indefinitely, or a linguistic unit can be embedded within another unit of the same type
The algorithm uses a recursive function to solve the problem.

relating to sculpture; having a form like a sculpture
The building had a very sculptural quality.

charming, confident, and elegant
He was a suave and sophisticated gentleman.

brief and clearly expressed
Her answer was succinct and to the point.

revealing; indicating something
The telltale signs of a cold were starting to appear.

in name only; relating to a title
She was the titular head of the organization, but held no real power.

in preparation or progress; happening or being planned
There are rumors that a major change is afoot in the company.

showing no symptoms of disease
Many people with the virus are asymptomatic.

shrewd and careful
He's a canny businessman who knows how to make a deal.

serving to compensate
The company offered compensatory damages for the inconvenience.

deserving blame
The jury found him culpable for the accident.

famous, especially by reputation; legendary
They searched for the fabled city of El Dorado.

relating to the femur or thigh
The doctor examined the patient's femoral artery.

tending to repel or fail to mix with water
Oil is a hydrophobic substance, which is why it doesn't mix with water.

unimportant under the circumstances; not consisting of matter
Whether he agrees or not is immaterial to the outcome.

relating to or tending to cause inflation
The government's policies led to an inflationary spiral.

Relating to the countries of the West.
The exhibition explored the differences between Oriental and Occidental art.

relating to or involving transactions
The company focuses on transactional banking services.

existing beyond what is obvious or admitted; secret
He suspected she had an ulterior motive for offering to help.

not open to more than one interpretation; clear
The instructions were unambiguous, leaving no room for confusion.

very typical of a certain kind of person or thing
He played the archetypal hero, brave and strong.

clever or skillful, especially in a cunning or crafty way
Her artful design combined traditional and modern elements.

not existing or happening at the same time
Online courses often use asynchronous learning methods.

lacking in originality, freshness, or novelty; commonplace
The movie's plot was so banal and predictable.

relating to capillaries (tiny blood vessels or tubes)
Capillary action allows water to move up narrow tubes.

relating to a director or the work of a director
His directorial debut received critical acclaim.

lacking a coherent sequence or connection
The speaker's argument was disjointed and hard to follow.

excessively harsh and severe
The new laws were criticized as draconian and unfair.

arousing or able to arouse intense feeling
The speaker used emotive language to sway the audience.

relating to an expedition
The expeditionary force prepared for their long journey.

unfortunate
The hapless victim was caught in the crossfire.

relating to humanism or the humanities
She has a very humanistic approach to education.

not allowing fluid to pass through; unable to be affected by
He seemed impervious to criticism.

not exactly known, established, or defined
The outcome of the negotiations remains indeterminate.

hard to control or deal with
The problem of poverty remains intractable for many governments.

Seemingly absurd or self-contradictory.
It's paradoxical that standing is more tiring than walking.

relating to the interrelation of social factors and individual thought and behavior
The study examined the psychosocial effects of long-term unemployment.

relating to or involving refraction
The lens has a high refractive index.

stubborn or unmanageable; resistant to a process or stimulus
The refractory patient refused to take his medication.

relating to William Shakespeare or his works
The actor delivered a powerful Shakespearean monologue.

lacking human qualities or warmth; without a soul
He found the modern architecture to be cold and soulless.

not able to be achieved or reached
His dream of becoming a rock star seemed unattainable.

not supported or proven by evidence
The claims were unsubstantiated and lacked any factual basis.

extremely severe or harmful in its effects; bitterly hostile
The disease was caused by a highly virulent strain of bacteria.

Relating to or consisting of alluvium (deposits of clay, silt, sand, and gravel left by flowing water).
The river formed rich alluvial plains over centuries.

Relating to or denoting an apex or tip.
The plant's apical bud is responsible for its vertical growth.

relating to the circulation of blood
The doctor explained the importance of a healthy circulatory system.

skillful and quick in movement
The magician performed the trick with a deft hand.

clear enough to be recognized or identified
The two sounds were barely distinguishable from each other.

serving as a symbol of something
The eagle is emblematic of freedom.

having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way
The pernicious influence of social media can be hard to escape.

stiffly formal and respectable
She was always very prim and proper in her behavior.

relating to or following a program or plan
The company adopted a programmatic approach to its marketing strategy.

relating to a spouse or marriage
The couple received spousal support after their divorce.

flexible; bending easily
The dancer's body was incredibly supple.

enhanced by a turbocharger; intensified
The new model features a turbocharged engine.

symbolic; representing something else
The story has an allegorical meaning about good versus evil.

relating to the way in which something is put together or arranged
The artist paid close attention to the compositional balance of the painting.

not important or significant
His remarks were inconsequential to the main discussion.

unable to pay debts owed
The company was declared insolvent and had to close down.

between galaxies
Scientists are studying intergalactic dust clouds.

relating to or involving iteration, especially of a procedure or process
The design process was iterative, with many cycles of feedback and refinement.
